WITH constructor_counts AS (
  SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count
  FROM constructors AS c
  LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs
    ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality
)
SELECT constructorId, nationality, record_count,
       record_count - AVG(record_count) OVER () AS difference_from_average
FROM constructor_counts
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
